# A divisor the fold finds to be zero is a division by zero when the program
# runs, on every target as on the interpreter. (One written as zero is an
# error of the check.) Go refuses one it can see at compile time, so the build
# failed rather than the test: the generated Go hands it over as no constant.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl test --platform=none main.sngl
stdout 'modulo by zero'
! sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go main.sngl
stdout 'FAIL: /ModuloByZero'
! sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go main.sngl
stdout 'FAIL: /ModuloByZero'

-- main.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const zero = 0

var n = 5

component page ui.node {
    ui.button #mod(text="{n}", @click { n = n % zero })
}

func testModuloByZero(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.mod.click()
    t.assert(n == 0)
}

ui.window {
    page
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/main.sngl/page/1 --
sha256:4abc9168d1bc0ddafee024c3b619b3fe
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "ModuloByZero",
      "Log": [
        "panic: runtime error: integer divide by zero"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
